propositions: Path.rglob traversal in the snapshot teardown fixture raises FileNotFoundError on Python 3.11 when cached directory entries vanish during recursion, specifically when LockHandle.release removes .ticket-write.lock.d mid-walk
The fixture must tolerate only FileNotFoundError for concurrently disappearing unrelated entries while preserving discovery of exact .rebar/run_snapshots roots and propagating other filesystem errors
os.walk with onerror callback tolerates vanished entries on both Python 3.11 and 3.12, whereas Path.rglob caches entries and lacks cross-version error suppression consistency

Conversion from Path.rglob to os.walk in tests/conftest.py and src/rebar/llm/workflow/snapshot.py must use type(tmp_path)(dirpath) instead of Path(dirpath) to avoid NotImplementedError when test monkeypatches os.name during fixture teardown on Python 3.11

Recursive snapshot cleanup is an autouse fixture that blocks teardown for all tests; failures must not mask unrelated PermissionError or other scan errors, and adjacent non-snapshot content must be preserved
